title: Researcher context
description: purpose-aware-research-calibration (2026-10-22): what the researcher carries into the study -- project purpose, research purpose (a concern the researcher cares about is written inside a purpose) and non-evidence business inputs (survey, word of mouth, desk research, stakeholder brief). Written by the researcher only; read downstream as framing and priority, never as evidence. The research purpose is mirrored to research_purpose.yaml for earlier readers.

issues.description: Written before 2026-10-23, when concerns were a separate list. Read for compatibility only: no stage receives it and the next save drops it.
